outcome: GBS severity (Hughes functional grading scale score)
cohort: 1001 Guillain-Barre syndrome (GBS) patients admitted to 31 tertiary hospitals in southern China between January 1, 2013 and September 30, 2016.
finding: Surgery, particularly orthopedic surgery, is identified as a potential trigger for GBS, with post-surgical GBS cases exhibiting a more severe course and poorer prognosis compared to general GBS.
